simple.meaning: צוֹם (tsôwm) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a fast.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 26 times across 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, and 8 more, beginning at 2 Samuel 12:16. Its contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צוֹם (H6685).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צוֹם (tsôwm) / H6685 is traced through 2 Samuel 12:16, 1 Kings 21:9, 1 Kings 21:12, 2 Chronicles 20:3 as a generated source-based concept entry.
